![](../../imagens/localdatasus-logo.png){width=160 fig-align="right"}

Brazil's public health data (DATASUS) usually comes by **municipality**. [microdatasus](https://github.com/rfsaldanha/microdatasus) downloads it at that level, and **localdatasus** goes down to the **neighborhood**. It combines four kinds of source:

- **microdata with the patient's postal code (CEP):** hospitalizations (SIH) and outpatient procedures such as chemotherapy, radiotherapy and dialysis;
- **state health department files:** for example, live births in Rio de Janeiro state, with the mother's postal code and neighborhood;
- **regional TabNet systems** that tabulate by neighborhood: Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Fortaleza and Santa Catarina;
- **open data portals**: arboviruses and SAMU emergency calls from Recife, primary care consultations from Curitiba (e-Saúde) and the national registry of health facilities (CNES).

Each neighborhood is linked to the **official IBGE neighborhood** (Brazil's census bureau). That link adds the 2022 Census population, a rate per 10,000 inhabitants and coordinates.

```r
library(localdatasus)

obitos_bairro("Rio de Janeiro", 2023, cid = "I")       # deaths from circulatory diseases
agravos_bairro("dengue", "Joinville", 2024)            # dengue cases
obitos_bairro("Fortaleza", 2023)                       # Fortaleza TabNet
estabelecimentos_bairro("Recife", tipo = "hospital")   # CNES, any municipality
mapa_bairro(obitos_bairro("São Paulo", 2023))          # ready-made map
```

## Neighborhood maps

Every table becomes a map with one line, `mapa_bairro()`, over IBGE's official neighborhood and district boundaries. Rates per 10,000 inhabitants:

## The package speaks Portuguese
Function names, messages and help pages are in Portuguese, like the Brazilian data sources themselves. The [tutorials](../../tutorials.qmd) on this site explain every function and argument in English.
:::

{{< include ../../_dados/localdatasus_versao.md >}}


## What it does

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `onde_tem_bairro()` | lists which data exist by neighborhood, where and for which years |
| `obitos_bairro()` | deaths by neighborhood, cause (ICD-10) and year |
| `nascimentos_bairro()` | live births by neighborhood |
| `agravos_bairro()` | notifiable diseases: dengue, tuberculosis, syphilis, violence... |
| `internacoes_bairro()` | public hospital admissions, located by the patient's postal code |
| `atendimentos_bairro()` | medical consultations in Curitiba's municipal network (e-Saúde), with ICD-10 |
| `samu_bairro()` | SAMU 192 emergency calls in Recife and its metropolitan area, by place of occurrence |
| `estabelecimentos_bairro()` | health facilities (CNES) by neighborhood, in any municipality |
| `mapa_bairro()`, `mapa_interativo()` | static and interactive maps |
| `ajuda()` | explains each error code |
